input.state_version: n/a at this level - reads are non-bumping; open/activate bumps flow through _call_raw

params.doc_a: string (required - the REFERENCE assembly: path or open title; normally the original)
params.doc_b: string (required - the candidate assembly: path or open title; normally the rebuild)

compare_assemblies.output: one line: verified_criteria=PASS/FAIL | components/set | transforms max deltas | mates | dV/dA

save_body_as_part.description: Extract ONE solid body of the ACTIVE (multibody) part into its own .SLDPRT (CreateFeatureFromBody3 on a fresh part from the default template; geometry stays in the SOURCE coordinates; the new doc is saved and closed, the source re-activated). The missing-parts half of flattened-assembly reconstruction (ADR-048): a structured assembly STEP with no per-part files flattens to a multibody import - each DISTINCT body becomes a referenced part file; instances then get transforms via fingerprint match + recovery.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

params.file_path: string (required - target .sldprt path; directory is created)

save_body_as_part.output: -> see execution-response.json - Features = [file name, 'body_name=<source body name>' when available]

check_interference.description: Interference detection in the active assembly (IAssemblyDoc.InterferenceDetectionManager, GetInterferences). With `components`: the named components plus the unsuppressed, visible leaf components whose bounding box (IComponent2.GetBox) comes within `clearance` of theirs are selected, and only interferences involving a named component are kept; lightweight ones among them are resolved. Without: the whole assembly. Optional clearance check: minimum distance (IMeasure, ArcOption 1) from each named component to each neighbour. Read-only; does NOT increment state_version.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

params.components: string or array (optional - JSON list of component names / instance paths to check against their neighbours; empty = whole assembly)
params.clearance: number (optional, default 0 - meters; > 0 needs components: report neighbours closer than this)
params.resolve_lightweight: boolean (optional, default false - ResolveAllLightWeightComponents before a whole-assembly check)
params.limit: integer (optional, default 100 - max interferences / violations listed)
params.compact: boolean (optional, default false - counts instead of long lists: not_measured_count + not_measured_neighbours, resolved_from_lightweight_count)
params.ignore_same_parent: boolean (optional, default false - leave out interferences / clearance violations whose components all share one parent sub-assembly; reported as ignored_same_parent)
params.boxes: boolean (optional, default false - neighbours as [{component, box_mm}], world bounding boxes)

check_interference.output: -> see execution-response.json - CadState.Features holds a single JSON string {assembly, checked, neighbours_checked?, neighbours? (not compact: instance paths), interference_count, interferences:[{components, volume_m3, volume_mm3, box_min?, box_max?, possible_only?}], interferences_truncated_at?, clearance?:{required_m, violation_count, violations:[{a, b, distance_m, distance_mm}], distances_mm? (not compact: every pair, null = not measured), nearest_m?, nearest_pair?, not_measured?}, lightweight_resolved?, resolved_from_lightweight?, lightweight_not_checked?, warning?, clear}.

check_path_clearance.description: Active assembly: checks a candidate bundle path before anything is drawn on it. Builds the path(s) as circular-profile sweeps (filleted polyline, as create_3d_path) in a temporary part (default part template, saved under %TEMP%\solidpilot_probe), inserts it at the assembly origin (identity transform), runs check_interference on that component (compact), maps each interference to the nearest path leg, then deletes the component, closes and deletes the part (unless keep_probe). Does not change state_version; the assembly is left marked modified.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

params.points: string (optional - JSON [[x,y,z],...] in meters, assembly coordinates; or use paths)
params.diameter: number (meters - bundle diameter; per path in paths)
params.bend_radii: string (optional - JSON list, one radius per corner)
params.paths: string or array (optional - JSON list of {points, bend_radii, bend_radius, diameter})
params.clearance: number (optional, meters, default 0 - also report neighbours closer than this)
params.ignore: string or array (optional - JSON list of name fragments to leave out of the report)
params.keep_probe: boolean (optional, default false - leave the probe component in the assembly)

check_path_clearance.output: → see execution-response.json — Features[0] = JSON {assembly, paths, path_length_mm[], neighbours_checked, interference_count, interferences:[{component, volume_mm3, box_mm, path?, leg, leg_points, at_mm_along_path, near_corner?}], clearance_mm?, clearance_violations?, nearest_mm?, nearest?, ignored?, path_warnings?, warning?, clear, probe_component?, note?, cleanup}

import_step.description: Imports a neutral file (STEP / IGES / Parasolid / SAT) through open_document's staged import, saves the import as a .SLDPRT (IModelDocExtension.SaveAs3; an assembly import becomes a multi-body part), closes the import document (ISldWorks.CloseDoc) and reopens the saved part (OpenDoc6) as the active document, so part queries work on it. Refuses to overwrite an existing part unless overwrite. Increments state_version.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

params.save_as: string (optional - .SLDPRT path; default next to the source with the same name)
params.overwrite: boolean (optional, default false - replace an existing save_as file)

import_step.output: -> see execution-response.json - CadState.ActiveDocument = the reopened part; Features[0] = JSON {source, part, imported_as: PART|ASSEMBLY, solid_bodies, surface_bodies?, box_min?, box_max?, size?, warning?}

routing_status.description: Read-only SOLIDWORKS Routing state: add-in (GetAddInObject), routing file locations and from-to header definitions (IRoutingSettings); for a part its ConnectionPoint/RoutePoint features and IRoutingComponentManager type; for an assembly its route sub-assemblies (IsRouteAssembly) and, for one route, its wires (IWire: references, pins, GetCuttingLength, GetRouteSegmentIDs, GetRouteErrors, IWireProperty) and segments (IElectricalRoute.GetSketchSegments, IRouteProperty). Does NOT change state_version.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

params.route: string (optional - a route sub-assembly instance to read wires and segments from)
params.verbose: boolean (optional, default false - every routing library location and the from-to header definitions)

routing_status.output: -> see execution-response.json - Features[0] = JSON {routing:{addin_object, file_locations, from_to_headers}, document, routing_points?, routing_component?, route_manager?, is_route_assembly?, edit_target?, route_assemblies?, route?:{component, wires[{name, from, to, cut_length_mm, segments, errors?, wire_name, color, diameter_mm}], cables_count, segments[{id, sketch_segments, length_mm, bend_radius_mm, bundle_diameter_mm}]}}

add_routing_point.description: Active part: a 3D sketch point, then a connection point (FeatureManager.InsertConnectionPoint, electrical, face mark 1 + point mark 1) or a route point (InsertRoutePoint), and/or the Routing component type (IRoutingComponentManager.SetComponentType + SetComponentRouteTypeToCustomProperty(electrical)). Increments state_version.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

params.face_index: integer (required for 'connection' - the cable exit face, analyze_model(faces) index)
params.point: string (required unless kind='none' - JSON [x,y,z] in meters, part coordinates)
params.name: string (optional - feature name; the point sketch becomes <name>_Sketch)
params.stub_length: number (optional, meters - default route stub length)
params.reverse: boolean (optional, default false - flip the exit direction)
params.direction: string (optional - JSON [dx,dy,dz], part coordinates: the outward normal of the cable exit, instead of face_index; the outermost such planar face is used)
params.verbose: boolean (optional, default false - full routing library locations)
params.exit_depth: number (optional, meters, default 0.001 - faces within this of the outermost one along direction are candidates)

add_routing_point.output: -> see execution-response.json - Features[0] = JSON {routing, sketch, inserted, feature, feature_type, routing_points, routing_component, warnings?}

import_from_to.description: Active assembly: sets component references (IComponent2.ComponentReference), fills empty from-to header definitions (IRoutingSettings.SetFromToListHeaderDefinitions), IRouteManager.ImportFromToList, RunCommand(PmOK) for the pages it opens, finds the new route sub-assembly, optionally IAutoRoute.ConvertGuidelinesToRoute, IElectricalRoute.RouteWires, and reads the route back. Increments state_version.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

params.references: string (optional, default '{}' - JSON {component instance: reference designator})
params.press_ok: integer (optional, default 3 - PmOK presses after the import)
params.route: string (optional - route to use when the import makes no new one)
params.edit_route_first: boolean (optional, default false - EditRoute on 'route' before the import)
params.replaces: string (optional - route sub-assembly deleted before the import, its Harness_<n> files after)
params.configurations: string or array (optional - JSON list: configurations showing the new route; the first is active for the import, the route is suppressed in the others)

import_from_to.output: -> see execution-response.json - Features[0] = JSON {imported, new_route?, route?:{component, wires, cables_count, segments}, route_assemblies, steps, warnings?} With replaces: deleted_files. With configurations: suppressed_in, active_configuration.

route_path.description: Active assembly: edits a route (Route feature + IRouteManager.EditRoute, unless one is being edited), adds connection points (AddToRoute), snaps the first / last point onto the nearest existing route sketch point within snap_tolerance, draws a filleted 3D polyline in the route sketch (AddToDB), merges points within merge_tolerance (MergePoints, also without points), optionally ExitRoute + EditAssembly + RouteWires. Increments state_version.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

params.route: string (optional - route sub-assembly instance, when none is being edited)
params.points: string (optional - JSON [[x,y,z],...] in meters, top-assembly coordinates)
params.bend_radii: string (optional - JSON list, one radius per corner)
params.dry_run: boolean (optional, default false - read the route sketch without EditRoute, snap and check, return the points and their geometry; draws nothing)
params.allow_free_ends: boolean (optional, default false - draw an end that sits on a corner a fillet removed)
params.free_end_tolerance: number (optional, meters, default 0.0005 - an unsnapped end this close to the tangent intersection of a route arc fails END_NOT_ON_ROUTE)
params.min_corner_deg: number (optional, degrees, default 10 - corners deflecting less are drawn sharp)
params.wire_paths: string (optional - JSON {wire: [segment ids] | "<other wire>"}: IWire.SetRoutePathForWire on exit, after RouteWires; e.g. a wire attached to the wrong connector takes the path of its twin)
